name: @emsenn/javascript-algebra
description: JavaScript type category — types as objects, functions as morphisms (a multicategory of types, domain is a tuple), and assignability as the carrier relation. Pure structure and operation; closures and section reads live in @emsenn/javascript-topology.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/package-boundary/copy-dmts-to-dts.mjs dist
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ".tmp/test-dist/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run audit:boundary
